nodes_file.description: Absolute path to the file containing one node IP per line. Each line must be an IPv4 or IPv6 address.

public_interfaces.description: List of network interface names used for public IP addresses (client-facing traffic).

private_interface.description: Network interface used for internal cluster communication (heartbeats, TDB replication, etc.).

locking_method.description: Locking backend: 'file' (legacy, less reliable) or 'tdb' (default, embedded database with better concurrency).

recovery_manager.description: Enable centralized recovery coordination (prevents split-brain). Must be true in production.

recovery_timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for recovery operations to complete before triggering a node failure.

node_health_check_interval.description: Seconds between health pings to other nodes. Lower values detect failures faster but increase overhead.

node_health_check_max_latency.description: Seconds of unresponsiveness before a node is declared unhealthy and failover may trigger.

recovery_strategy.description: Recovery behavior: 'balanced' (distribute load evenly) or 'manual' (manual failover only).

log_level.description: Verbosity of CTDB logs. Use 'DEBUG' only for troubleshooting.

log_file.description: Absolute path for CTDB log file (requires directory to exist with proper permissions).

transport.description: Network transport for inter-node communication: 'tcp' (default), 'rdma' (low-latency), or 'both' (experimental).

socket_reuse_port.description: Enable SO_REUSEPORT for TCP listening sockets — improves performance on multi-core systems.

tcp_no_delay.description: Enable TCP_NODELAY to disable Nagle’s algorithm — reduces latency (recommended).

tcp_backlog.description: TCP listen() backlog size — increase under very high connection rates.

workers_per_ip.description: Worker threads per public IP. Set to 0 (auto) to match number of CPU cores. Set >0 for manual control.

public_addresses.description: List of public IP address blocks assigned to clients (e.g., for virtual IP failover). Each item defines one IP/prefix/interface.

prefixlen.description: Subnet mask length in CIDR notation (e.g., 24 for 255.255.255.0)

enable_ha.description: Enable high-availability mode (required for public IP management and failover).

service_check_script.description: Absolute path to script that checks if local services (e.g., Samba) are healthy. Return 0 if OK.

failover_delay.description: Seconds to wait after a service health check fails before initiating failover (prevents flapping).

database_cache_size.description: Number of database records to cache in memory per node. Increase for workloads with many small records.

queue_depth.description: Maximum pending operations per database. Increase under high concurrency to avoid backpressure.

remote_tdb_timeout.description: Seconds before remote TDB operations (e.g., locks) are considered failed.

use_sasl.description: Enable SASL authentication for inter-node communication (advanced — requires SASL setup).

sasl_config_path.description: Path to SASL configuration file if SASL is enabled. Must be identical across all nodes.
